paragraphs: Rav Huna bar Torta saw a snake and a tzav entwined, and an arod emerged from between them. “When I came before Rabbi Shimon the Pious …”: Chullin 127a. In the midrash: because his cow observed the Sabbath and he became Jewish on its account, he was called Ben Torta. See above, Yochanan ben Torta, what is written there; and Rabbi Chanina, at length there.
